page: Amazon Web Services m8id.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance features 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided by a 950 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 8 Gbps.

The x86_64 architecture of the processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for matrix multiplication. Cryptographic acceleration is supported via AES and SHA_NI instructions, alongside hardware-enforced security features like Total Memory Encryption (TME).

In benchmark evaluations, the m8id.4xlarge demonstrates strong single-core performance, scoring 2204.0 in Geekbench single-core and achieving top-tier results in text processing and small-model LLM text generation. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth remain in the average tier, with a Passmark CPU score of 29279.13 and a Redis SET throughput of 30.29 million operations per second. This profile makes the instance suitable for database operations, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads requiring fast local storage.
